svg.aria-label: Drawing CLR-HW-601: CLEAR TAP · M2 DOCK
svg.text: 1. HOLDS A STRIPE READER M2 (73.5 × 67 × 19.5) AS SUPPLIED. NOTHING IS OPENED, GLUED OR COVERED: TAP FACE, LIGHTS AND CARD SLOT STAY CLEAR.
2. READER SLIDES IN FROM THE TOP BETWEEN THE RAILS; 1.6 LIPS HOLD IT. BUTTON WINDOW ON ONE RAIL. CONFIRM WHICH EDGE CARRIES THE CHIP SLOT ON A REAL
3. 46 MM UNDER THE READER LEAVES ROOM FOR A CHIP CARD. USB-C CABLE RUNS DOWN THE BACK CHANNEL AND OUT THE BASE.
4. STEEL PLATE 72 × 80 × 4 IN THE BASE. PETG OR ASA; PRINT ON ITS BACK. M4 HOLES OPTIONAL FOR THE DRAWER'S TOP PANEL.
SCALE 1:1 · HIDDEN: STEEL PLATE, CABLE CHANNEL
